pack.title: Distance Between Equally Spaced Objects - Word Problems
pack.subject: Maths

questions.stem: 6 trees are placed at equal distances along a straight road. The distance between the first and the third tree is 12 metres. What is the distance between the third and the sixth tree?

8 lamp posts are placed at equal distances along a straight garden path. The distance between the second and the fifth lamp post is 18 metres. What is the distance between the first and the eighth lamp post?
9 benchs are placed at equal distances along a straight jogging track. The distance between the fourth and the seventh bench is 24 metres. What is the distance between the second and the ninth bench?
10 bollards are placed at equal distances along a straight lane. The distance between the third and the sixth bollard is 15 metres. What is the distance between the first and the tenth bollard?
12 flags are placed at equal distances along a straight track. The distance between the fifth and the eleventh flag is 30 metres. What is the distance between the third and the twelfth flag?

7 street lights are placed at equal distances along a straight highway. The distance between the first and the fourth street light is 21 metres. What is the distance between the second and the seventh street light?
11 plants are placed at equal distances along a straight fence. The distance between the second and the seventh plant is 25 metres. What is the distance between the first and the eleventh plant?
13 markers are placed at equal distances along a straight trail. The distance between the third and the eighth marker is 30 metres. What is the distance between the fifth and the thirteenth marker?
14 poles are placed at equal distances along a straight field. The distance between the fourth and the ninth pole is 35 metres. What is the distance between the first and the fourteenth pole?
15 stones are placed at equal distances along a straight walkway. The distance between the fifth and the tenth stone is 40 metres. What is the distance between the second and the fifteenth stone?

16 torchs are placed at equal distances along a straight campsite path. The distance between the sixth and the eleventh torch is 45 metres. What is the distance between the first and the sixteenth torch?
17 cones are placed at equal distances along a straight driveway. The distance between the seventh and the twelfth cone is 50 metres. What is the distance between the third and the seventeenth cone?

18 signs are placed at equal distances along a straight corridor. The distance between the eighth and the thirteenth sign is 55 metres. What is the distance between the fourth and the eighteenth sign?
19 posts are placed at equal distances along a straight track. The distance between the ninth and the fourteenth post is 60 metres. What is the distance between the fifth and the nineteenth post?

20 panels are placed at equal distances along a straight solar grid. The distance between the tenth and the fifteenth panel is 65 metres. What is the distance between the sixth and the twentieth panel?
10 seats are placed at equal distances along a straight auditorium row. The distance between the first and the sixth seat is 20 metres. What is the distance between the third and the tenth seat?
12 steps are placed at equal distances along a straight staircase. The distance between the second and the seventh step is 25 metres. What is the distance between the fourth and the twelfth step?
14 bulbs are placed at equal distances along a straight ceiling line. The distance between the third and the eighth bulb is 30 metres. What is the distance between the sixth and the fourteenth bulb?

16 bells are placed at equal distances along a straight school corridor. The distance between the fourth and the ninth bell is 35 metres. What is the distance between the seventh and the sixteenth bell?
18 mirrors are placed at equal distances along a straight hallway. The distance between the fifth and the tenth mirror is 40 metres. What is the distance between the eighth and the eighteenth mirror?
